::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 29 1895  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book, Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/59/187
:::

Dear Madam
I expect to receive the Policy from the Norwich Union Office in a day or two & will then forward it to [Mrs. Yonge](people/person_1604.qmd)as you wish.  You know of course that at the present time the Policy is absolutely your property & stands in your name with the Company

I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

Miss Yonge
Lady Seaton’s[Beechwood](organizations/other_126.qmd) Devon
